# Third-party notices and attribution

## Pedagogical inspiration

### dostackbufferoverflowgood (Justin Steven)

- Project: https://github.com/justinsteven/dostackbufferoverflowgood
- Code license: Apache License 2.0
- Tutorial/slides license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International

This repository reimplements a **similar teaching approach** (intentionally
vulnerable TCP service, stack SRP overwrite, JMP ESP, shellcode) with new
source, Python 3 exploits, and WinDBG/mona3-first documentation. We do not
copy the CC-BY tutorial text or slides. If you use Justin’s original materials
alongside this repo, retain his attribution.
